reviewer: arm-c independent agent; direct native-pixel inspection with view_image(detail=original)

embodiment_body_ownership.evidence: At native 1237x1272 scale, the viewer-left pinching hand connects through its forearm and rolled sleeve to the same woman, and the viewer-right stabilizing hand connects to her other arm. No donor hand or duplicated limb is visible.

embodiment_joint_chain_and_reach.evidence: The forward-leaning torso and flexed elbows reach the nearby sheet and map; connected wrist and finger directions agree with the targets. Both arms are visibly continuous through shirt sleeves.

embodiment_support_and_balance.evidence: The maps lie on the luminous horizontal table; only a light front corner of the tracing layer is lifted. The leaning torso is plausible with ordinary off-frame standing support; no unsupported load-bearing body state is required.

embodiment_contact_and_space.evidence: The hand at viewer-left visibly pinches the raised sheet corner between thumb and forefinger; the other hand rests its fingers against the underlying map. Material edges meet the fingers coherently and enough table space remains around each hand.

embodiment_visibility_and_projection.evidence: The face, both hands, lifted tracing corner and visible coastlines are all within the saved frame and inspectable at native resolution. The critical pinch boundary is visible; ordinary sleeve and torso cropping does not conceal that relation.

user_judgment.evidence: No direct requesting-user acceptance or comparative preference has been received. The inherited wire field is not an authored claim about a moe theme.

supplemental_observations.initial_impression_ko: 따뜻한 작업대와 푸른 저녁창 사이에서 얼굴과 손이 가까이 느껴지는 집중된 작업 초상. 표정은 과장되지 않고, 손끝에 붙잡힌 얇은 종이가 작업의 촉감을 만든다.
strengths_ko: 짧은 어두운 머리와 부드러운 얼굴·입술 형태가 참조를 따른다.
안쪽으로 내려간 시선, 펼친 지도, 잡고 있는 시트가 같은 작업으로 연결된다.
전경 지도에서 얼굴로 올라가는 정보 흐름이 분명하다.
weaknesses_ko: 주요 초안 관계인 중앙 선 일치→국소 만 차이의 정확한 패턴은 보이지 않는다.
모델이 책 더미·설명 라벨·램프 등 주변 표지를 추가해 원래의 간결한 기록실보다 다소 연출된 느낌이 강하다.
supplemental_observations.control_comparison_ko: 첫 인상을 먼저 기록한 뒤 동결 제어와 비교했다. 은은한 사람의 매력은 가까운 거리와 부드럽게 열린 입술에서 읽히며 과장되지 않는다. 특정 물질의 성적 초점이나 현실 이탈은 관찰되지 않는다. 이 판단은 설정값의 숫자나 감사 결과만으로 만든 증명이 아니다.
supplemental_observations.artistic_success: Coherent and engaging working portrait at the chosen scale, while strict authored-map relation fidelity fails.
